content.text:
The researcher moved from uni_owns_option_to_licence (which they proposed) vs my company_owns_uni_academic_use. They also moved review days from 60 to 30. I need to counter: I'll move on IP to uni_owns_option_to_assign (gives us path to full ownership) and keep 60 review days or accept 30. Let me think about what's most important.

Key needs: usable engine in NjivaManager, confidentiality of soil/weather data, milestone-based handover.

uni_owns_option_to_licence means we only get a licence - not ideal for maintaining the engine internally. uni_owns_option_to_assign would give us the option to take full ownership. That's better for us than option_to_licence.
So I'll accept their 30-day review concession and counter on the IP field by pushing for option_to_assign instead of option_to_licence—that keeps the trade to two field changes total.
